steps.note: S1.1.1.a states rows 0-1 subtract the old scratch contributions, rows 2-5 add the source effect, rows 6-7 restore the scratch, so the net target change is (JV+RG)x independent of the initial scratch values.
S1.1.1.b gives the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, side wires cancelling exactly the intersection-one cases, zero coefficient for intersections zero/two, and self coefficient one.
S1.1.1.c gives the complex central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2, side wires cancelling intersections zero and two, intersection one contributing zero, self coefficient one.
S1.1.2 states the three stages (x,y) -> (x,y+x) -> (-y,y+x) -> (-y,x) and that each invocation restores its own auxiliary wires.

The plan asserts that every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels (S1.3.5) but never lists the per-edge orthogonal residuals and dimensions of the residual table; only the single decreasing-edge residual P(x)F appears.
No step gives the side edge 2->5 argument (t_X perp t_Y, <t_X> in t_Y^perp, complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2); S1.3.1 only says neighbouring triple lines are orthogonal.

S1.3.5 names center 3->4 as the only decreasing edge losing h, S1.3.2 gives sources N, sinks Wm-N and signed Wm-2N with gate contributions cancelling, and S1.3.6 gives Ic decreasing edges, L=Ich and absolute Wm-2N+2L.
S1.3.5 only asserts that every nonzero binary residual has an orthonormal basis; the nondegenerate and nonalternating argument and the absorption of alternating planes are not stated.
S1.3.7 states L_b/N = 100/539 and L_c/N = 101/539, both below 1/2.
S1.4.2 gives the weight identity, additivity mod 4 on orthogonal vectors, and q_V - q_U = sum over an orthonormal basis of wt(v)[v.x] mod 4, negated on a decreasing edge.
S1.4.3 gives wt(v) odd, phase i^{eps[v.x]} expanded in the character, and H diag(1,-1) H = X sending the character to translation, giving aI+bX_v or its inverse.
The plan counts kernels (s_c) and mentions C^{tensor mk} in the corrections, but never states that on k columns each residual vector contributes one factor K^{tensor k} acting on all columns.

S1.4.5 gives frames I and C^{tensor m} for zero/full labels and C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates for X_a->Y_a; S1.4.6 gives C = iZC^{-1}Z, Z_{a,k} before and i^{27k}Z_{a,k} after, and the negation of the physical X outputs.
S1.3 states s = Wm - N + 2L < Wm because L/N = 100/539 < 1/2, and S1.3.8.b states the deficit N - 2L_b > 0 from W_b m.
S1.5.2 gives both deficits above 20*2^-50 and S1.5.3 gives log m < 20, m^{1-2^-50} > m(1-20*2^-50) > m(1-eta), hence s/W < m^tau with tau = sigma = 1-2^-50.
S2.1.1.a-c give the pivot at the topmost nonzero row's rightmost entry, clearing by lower triangular elementary matrices, deletion of pivot row/column and repetition, and Pi with exactly a ones.
S2.1 only says 'for a suitable fixed odd prime q'; the plan never says the prime avoids every denominator in a finite table of factors so the identities specialize with invertible triangular factors.
S2.1.2 states a lower triangular transformation costs O(V) by updating coordinates in descending physical order, each from earlier still-unchanged coordinates.
S2.1.4 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, the interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi, and S2.1.5 states one interchange per one, so a in all.

S3.5 gives E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, C_0=128mB^2, C_1=20 and Delta=ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}); nu and C_1=max{20,nu+3} are not written out, but the value C_1=20 is stated (borderline, counted present since all constants used later are given).
The plan never states the arithmetic-depth recurrence A(e) <= sA(e/m)+E (internal) and A(e) <= 8e (leaf); S3.4.5's F(e) recurrence is the time recurrence, not this one.
No unrolling (B^{k+1} <= B^2 d^nu, A(e) <= 8B^2 d^{nu+1}) or total below C_0 d^{C_1} is given; S3.5 only asserts Delta bounds the growth.

S3.5 gives fractional width p+Delta and epsilon*C_1<1 implying Delta=o(p), but not the depth-l statement (values in 2^{-(p+l)}Z[i], modulus at most 2^l) nor the Delta+3 integer bits, which are the derivation.
S3.6 states every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disk arrays are preserved and componentwise truncation errs by less than sqrt2 * 2^-p.

summary: 18 of 26 sub-steps present. Present: B1-B4, L3, L5, P1, P2, P4, R1-R4, M1, M3, M4, S1 (borderline: nu omitted, C_1=20 given), S5. Absent: L1 (residual table), L2 (side edge 2->5), L4 (binary orthonormal basis only asserted), P3 (k-column tensoring), M2 (prime avoiding denominators), S2, S3, S4 (the guard-width derivation is only asserted in S3.5).
